rows.note: The board treats Engineering majors with the five-course structure and everyone else with the six-course structure. Hotel School students need the core course, two concentration courses, HADM 3740, HADM 4760 and one elective, so confirm that structure with the minor advisor.

rows.note: Transfer and exam credit are refused by the course rows; study abroad credit cannot be seen on the board, so check it yourself.
